description:
`CallSiteSummary::replace_targets_join_returns` and `CallSiteSummary::coalesce_targets` call `merge_callsite_activation` only after `same_call_target` has matched the same callee and the full `Option<ActivationKey>`. Neither path mutates an activation between that match and the helper call. The helper therefore receives only equal `Some`/`Some` values or `None`/`None`; its `Some`/`Some` arm is a no-op, its `None`/`Some` assignment is unreachable, and its fallback is a no-op.

Verified at origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`:

- `same_call_target` at `src/compiler2/semantic.rs:203-205` requires equal callee and activation.
- The only two helper callsites are the replace path at lines 129-143 and the coalesce path at 160-162, both after that match.
- Stable line coverage of the focused tests reaches the helper twice, both through equal `Some`/`Some`; the assigning `None`/`Some` arm is never reached.
- The four `callsite_summary` semantic tests pass.

Delete both `merge_callsite_activation` invocations and delete the helper itself. Do not replace them with a shim or explanatory dead-code comment. Preserve `same_call_target`'s callee-plus-activation identity and the existing surface/input/return joins.

Verify with the callsite-summary semantic tests, including repeated equal-activation snapshots, replacement by a different activation of the same callee, and preservation of distinct activations for one callee.
title: Remove the semantically inert callsite-activation merge helper
